# Fully-pinned direct and transitive versions for a reproducible install.

# GENERATED FILE — do not hand-edit. Regenerate with:
#   PYTHON=python3.10 bash scripts/regen-constraints.sh
#
# Resolved on the 3.10 floor on purpose: aiohttp and pytest gate
# transitives behind python_version < "3.11", so a resolve on a newer
# interpreter omits them and the result breaks on the floor. The extra
# pins are inert elsewhere — a constraint only binds a package that is
# actually installed.
#
# pyproject.toml is the source of truth for what is ALLOWED (ranges);
# this file records what was actually VERIFIED (exact versions).
#
# Use:
#   pip install -c constraints.txt .            # runtime
#   pip install -c constraints.txt -e '.[dev]'  # development
#
# pip/setuptools/wheel are omitted deliberately: they are the installer,
# not part of the application's dependency closure.
